data.body: Fixed: corrected misleading comments in test_augmentation_post_nudge_request_with_findings_is_ignored. call_count==2 branch comment now correctly says aug_turn=0 normal turn with soft_cap=2 not yet reached (not 'triggers soft cap nudge'). else branch comment now explains that call 3+ fires at both aug_turn=1 normal turn and after nudge at aug_turn=2, with the post-nudge check (nudge_count>=1 and has_findings) breaking the loop.
